map.星轨拍摄时长 使用指南: Star Trail Exposure Length User Guide
map.星轨拍摄时长计算器按 500 法则估算不出现明显拖线的最长曝光时间，适合星空、星: The star trail exposure length calculator uses the 500 rule to estimate the longest exposure without visible trailing, suited to shutter settings for starry sky and star trail photography and for landscape coordination.
map.500 法则：曝光秒数 ≤ 500 / (焦距 × 裁切系数)NPF 更精确，考: 500 rule: exposure seconds <= 500 / (focal length x crop factor). NPF is more accurate because it accounts for pixel size.
map.由焦距算星空不拖尾最长快门。: Compute the longest shutter for pinpoint star trails from focal length.
map.500 法则与 NPF 近似对比。: Approximate comparison of the 500 rule and NPF.
map.广角长曝星轨。: Wide-angle long exposures for star trails.
map.：24mm 全幅：500/24 ≈ 20.8s，超过则星点拖线；想拉星轨故意用: 24mm on full frame: 500/24 = about 20.8s; beyond that star points trail, and to deliberately draw star trails you use an exposure of several minutes.
map.：NPF ≈ (35×像元尺寸µm)/焦距，24mm、像元 4µm：≈ 35×4: NPF = (35 x pixel size in um) / focal length; at 24mm with 4um pixels: 35 x 4/24 = about 5.8s, more conservative than the 500 rule and giving rounder points.
map.500 和 NPF 哪个准？: Which is more accurate, the 500 rule or NPF?
map.500 法则宽松适合网络图，NPF 考虑像元尺寸更严、高像素机用 NPF 防像素: The 500 rule is lenient and suits web images; NPF accounts for pixel size and is stricter, so high-resolution bodies should use NPF to avoid pixel-level trailing.
map.广角能更久吗？: Can a wide lens go longer?
map.能，焦距越短允许越久；但地球自转固定，超长仍拖，星轨需数分钟起。: Yes, the shorter the focal length the longer you can go; but Earth's rotation is fixed, so very long exposures still trail and star trails need minutes.
